system.description: You touch a person who is Doomed, Infected or otherwise afflicted, and scream as you draw the corruption out of them and into yourself.

outcomes.triumph: They are cured, and you suffer the symptoms for only one day.
outcomes.success: They are cured instantly. You suffer the symptoms (but not the death) of the affliction for d4 days.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the corruption will not move.
outcomes.ruin: The corruption spreads to you, and they are not cured. You suffer the symptoms for d4 days. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
